expected.executiveSummary: The TF24 weekly check-in reviewed progress against the technical-file remediation tracker. Key priorities remained risk/software, subcontractors and usability. Software alarm changes were largely complete but needed mute-button, clinical and usability review; language changes and versioning work remained in progress; and electrical compliance testing would now be completed in-house. The meeting also covered risk management, cybersecurity, subcontractor justifications, usability study planning, process maps, marketing, accelerated testing, biocomp, PMS comments and the TF03 MDR findings submission.
